headline: Executive order bars the federal government from discriminating against its workers based on their genetic information.
what_it_does: This executive order forbids discrimination in federal employment based on genetic information. It applies to the federal government as an employer. The title does not give details on how the rule works or is enforced.

who_it_affects.how: They are protected from employment discrimination by the federal government based on their genetic information.
They may be protected from being treated differently in federal hiring because of their genetic information.
They are prohibited from making employment decisions based on genetic information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 8, 2000; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
